description: Fixtures for the xebench benchmarks contract 1.3 (data/benchmarks.schema.json, docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md): dateBasis on rows without versions. Each file is a complete envelope. producerMustNotEmit=true marks a file that breaks a producer rule: scripts/validate_data.mjs refuses it. consumerExpectation is what the website does with it. dateBasis is never displayed; it tells a reader of the data whether sourceDate is the measurement month or the first-published month. tests/test_contract_1_3.py checks producerMustNotEmit against scripts/validate_data.mjs.

fixtures.notes: Two July 2026 rows without versions (dateBasis measured and first-published) and a vendor row
fixtures.consumerExpectation: rendered: each lab row shows "Jul 2026" and no version; dateBasis is not shown

fixtures.notes: 1.3 is additive: rows without dateBasis are unchanged

fixtures.producerRule: dateBasis is only valid on legacy rows
dateBasis is only valid on legacy rows

fixtures.consumerExpectation: rendered without a month; dateBasis is ignored
